_why: Judged before any embedding, on the pre-registered reasons: not a photograph (documents, caption cards, copies of art), colour photographs, portraits of the photographer, film border, sleeve or caption filling more than about a tenth of the centre square, and a second frame of the same scene and moment (the lower index kept). Border bands were measured, not eyeballed: border_check.py flags uniform dark or light edge bands over 0.10 of the centre square (borders.json); each flagged file was then looked at, and flat sky or plain walls were kept (evans 0013, lange 0315 0747, mydans 0008 0013 0028, rothstein 0008, shahn 0000, wolcott 0046). Toned print mats and handwritten captions, which the measurement cannot see, were judged by eye.

_reasons.delano: photographer dropped: 32 of 45 are colour (Kodachrome); 13 black-and-white left, below the floor of 20
_reasons.vachon: photographer dropped: his category includes his 1970s colour work; 22 black-and-white, then 0083, 0171 (border) and 0092 (a photograph of an advertisement) leave 19 or fewer, below 20
_reasons.wolcott: photographer dropped: 21 of 45 colour; of the 24 black-and-white, 8 have measured film borders (0057 0092 0097 0137 0143 0149 0218 0235), leaving 16
_reasons.rothstein 0124, 0132, 0178: photographs of relief sculpture (copies of art)
_reasons.rothstein 0225: a print on a wide mat (toned margin)
_reasons.shahn 0050: a print on a wide toned mat
_reasons.shahn 0061, 0082, 0086: handwritten caption on the print margin
_reasons.evans 0002: colour calibration target and mat beside the print
_reasons.evans 0011: a painted wall filling the frame (copy of art)
_reasons.mydans 0000: a pasted print with a caption (caption card)
